summary: Completed read-only Coze-to-M8A connector research package using existing local M8A artifacts only. No files were modified or created. Recommendation: GO for a mock-first Coze provider adapter design behind Mission Control, Approval, Worker Runner, and Exception Framework; NO-GO for live Coze API calls, credential use, deployment, or production execution until CEO approval is granted.

test_results.name: read_only_workspace_review
test_results.notes: Reviewed local COTAS and Coze integration artifacts already present in the M8A workspace. No file edits, creates, deletes, moves, commits, deploys, or external calls were performed.

test_results.name: external_platform_safety_check
test_results.notes: No Coze API, external API, external platform, web, or network access was called during this research-mode execution.

test_results.name: m8a_boundary_validation
test_results.notes: Coze must be treated only as an Agent Provider or Workflow Provider. It must not become Commander, Mission Control, Approval authority, direct publisher, or direct database writer.

test_results.name: mock_first_adapter_feasibility
test_results.notes: A mock-first adapter can be designed without credentials or external API access, with future live execution gated by CEO approval.

risks: No external API/platform was called in this execution; endpoint details remain research-plan candidates and must be re-verified against current official Coze documentation before live implementation.
Coze authentication, workspace permissions, bot/workflow publish state, rate limits, timeout behavior, and response schemas must be confirmed before staging use.
Real credentials must never be written to source code, logs, prompts, reports, artifacts, or test fixtures.
Workflow outputs may vary by Coze workflow design; M8A must validate every response before saving artifacts or creating approvals.
Coze-generated content or tool results must not bypass Mission Control, CEO Approval, or Exception Framework.
Any authentication failure, timeout, schema mismatch, provider error, or blocked state must route to Exception Framework.
next_steps: QA Agent reviews this COTAS result as a research artifact.
CEO approves or rejects proceeding to a separate implementation mission.
If approved, create a mock-only Coze Provider Adapter V1 implementation mission.
Implement adapter contract, schema validation, mock response handling, failure routing, and tests without real credentials.

approval_reason: CEO approval is required before any implementation, credential handling, external API call, Coze platform connection, deployment, or production workflow execution.

artifacts.title: Coze API to M8A Connector and Adapter Plan

integration_plan.positioning: Coze should be integrated as a controlled Agent Provider or Workflow Provider behind M8A Agent Dispatcher.
integration_plan.go_no_go_recommendation: GO for mock-first adapter design; NO-GO for live API execution until CEO approval.
capability_summary: Run an approved Coze workflow from structured M8A task input.
Receive structured workflow output as JSON.
Convert accepted workflow output into an M8A artifact.
Create approval records for customer-facing, public, publishing, or external-action outputs.
Route provider failures through Exception Framework.
not_allowed_in_v1: Direct database mutation outside Mission Control.

required_credentials.name: COZE_API_BASE_URL
required_credentials.purpose: Base URL for future approved Coze API calls.

required_credentials.name: COZE_API_TOKEN
required_credentials.purpose: Server-side bearer token or personal access token for controlled staging only after approval.

required_credentials.name: COZE_WORKFLOW_ID
required_credentials.purpose: Identifier for the approved Coze workflow to run.

required_credentials.name: COZE_WORKSPACE_ID
required_credentials.purpose: Workspace or project scope if required by the chosen Coze API mode.

required_credentials.name: COZE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
required_credentials.purpose: Optional secret for webhook verification if webhook mode is approved later.

api_endpoints.purpose: Candidate endpoint for running a Coze workflow with structured input. Must be verified before live use.
Candidate endpoint for streaming workflow execution if streaming is needed. Must be verified before live use.
Candidate endpoint for retrieving workflow execution status or history. Must be verified before live use.

runtime_flow: Mission Control creates the mission and task.
Agent Dispatcher selects Coze Provider Adapter only for approved integration tasks.
Worker Runner invokes adapter in mock mode first.
Adapter validates input schema and approval context.
Adapter returns mock result or approved provider result.
Adapter saves result as M8A artifact through controlled intake.
Adapter creates approval when output can affect public/customer/external state.
Adapter routes failures to Exception Framework.
security_rules: Use environment variables or secure credential storage only.
Never write credential values to code, prompts, reports, tests, or artifacts.
Use mock mode unless CEO approves real integration.
Treat all external write actions as approval-gated.

test_plan.name: schema_validation_success
test_plan.expected: Valid M8A task input produces a normalized adapter request.

test_plan.name: schema_validation_failure
test_plan.expected: Missing mission_id, task_id, workflow_id, or input_json returns failed/blocked status and routes to Exception Framework.

test_plan.name: mock_workflow_success
test_plan.expected: Mock Coze response is converted into a valid M8A artifact payload without external API calls.

test_plan.name: credential_absent_in_mock_mode
test_plan.expected: Mock mode does not require or read real Coze credentials.

test_plan.name: credential_required_in_staging_mode
test_plan.expected: Staging mode blocks execution if approved credential references are missing.

test_plan.name: timeout_failure_routing
test_plan.expected: Provider timeout is converted to failed status and routed to Exception Framework.

test_plan.name: approval_gate
test_plan.expected: Customer-facing or publishing-related results create an approval instead of direct external action.

required_assertions: external_api_called must be false for mock tests.
credentials_used must be false for mock tests.
No secret value may appear in test output.
Failures must verify Exception Framework routing.

risk_points: Endpoint paths and authentication behavior must be verified against official Coze documentation in an approved research or staging sprint.
Workflow output schemas are workflow-specific and require strict validation.
External write or publish behavior must remain blocked until explicit approval.
Credential leakage risk requires environment-only secret handling and masked logs.
Retries must be idempotent to avoid duplicate artifacts or actions.
approval_points: CEO approval before implementation files are created or modified.
CEO approval before configuring any real Coze credential.
CEO approval before any network call to Coze.
CEO approval before enabling staging mode.
CEO approval before any production workflow execution.
CEO approval before any public, customer-facing, publishing, or external write action.
